verses.text: This is the written record of Adam's family line. When God created human beings, he made them to be like God.
He created them male and female, and he blessed them. On the day they were created, he called them "human beings".
When Adam was a hundred and thirty years old, he had a son who was like him, in his own image. He named him Seth.
After Seth was born, Adam lived eight hundred more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Adam lived nine hundred and thirty years in all, and then he died.
When Seth was a hundred and five years old, he became the father of Enosh.
After Enosh was born, Seth lived eight hundred and seven more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Seth lived nine hundred and twelve years in all, and then he died.
When Enosh was ninety years old, he became the father of Kenan.
After Kenan was born, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Enosh lived nine hundred and five years in all, and then he died.
When Kenan was seventy years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
After Mahalalel was born, Kenan lived eight hundred and forty more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Kenan lived nine hundred and ten years in all, and then he died.
When Mahalalel was sixty-five years old, he became the father of Jared.
After Jared was born, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Mahalalel lived eight hundred and ninety-five years in all, and then he died.
When Jared was a hundred and sixty-two years old, he became the father of Enoch.
After Enoch was born, Jared lived eight hundred more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Jared lived nine hundred and sixty-two years in all, and then he died.
When Enoch was sixty-five years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
After Methuselah was born, Enoch walked closely with God for three hundred years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Enoch lived three hundred and sixty-five years in all.
Enoch walked closely with God. Then he was gone, because God took him away.
When Methuselah was a hundred and eighty-seven years old, he became the father of Lamech.
After Lamech was born, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Methuselah lived nine hundred and sixty-nine years in all, and then he died.
When Lamech was a hundred and eighty-two years old, he had a son.
He named him Noah, and said, "He will bring us relief from our hard work and the painful labour of our hands, caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed."
After Noah was born, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five more years, and he had other sons and daughters.
Lamech lived seven hundred and seventy-seven years in all, and then he died.
After Noah was five hundred years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
